credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe leaving church; O'Keeffe is in the foreground dressed in a black dress, matching jacket with a silver dome pin, and a black wide brim hat and her white head scarf; she carries a black purse on her bent arm, behind her is  adobe church with vigas and cross over the white wooden doors with three parishioners: a man in a cowboy hat and jeans, a woman in a broomstick skirt and concho belt, and a young girl in jeans and a ponytail with bangs.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe in Front of a Church
